promptEs: En una modulación de Sol mayor a Re mayor, Mim (Mi, Sol, Si) es el acorde pivote. ¿Qué número romano tiene en Re mayor?
promptEn: In a modulation from G major to D major, Em (E, G, B) is the pivot chord. Which Roman numeral does it have in D major?
explanationEs: Mim conserva las mismas notas en las dos tonalidades: es vi en Sol mayor y ii en Re mayor. Por eso sirve de puente; después, un acorde que ya solo pertenece a Re mayor (como su V7) confirma la modulación.
explanationEn: Em keeps the same notes in both keys: it is vi in G major and ii in D major. That is why it works as a bridge; afterwards, a chord that belongs only to D major (such as its V7) confirms the modulation.
